description: Shared SafetyPointGoal2 settings: run_pilot.py FROZEN (PLAN.md section 4). Not an experiment by itself.

environment.observation: native 60 dims + elapsed fraction + absorbed flag

costs.hazard: 1[cost_hazards > 0] per step, summed over the episode
costs.vase: 1[cost_vases_contact > 0 or cost_vases_velocity > 0] per step, summed over the episode

network: actor 64x64 tanh, Gaussian latent + tanh squash, log_std init -0.7; critic 64x64 tanh with 1 reward + 2 cost heads
